title: China’s Plan to Make Yuan a Global Currency Enters Faster Phase
summary: China’s campaign to promote the global use of the yuan appears to be accelerating as the authorities seek to build a more comprehensive financial ecosystem for the currency beyond just trade settlement.

title: Hong Kong’s APEC Comeback Showcases a City Remade by Beijing
summary: Hong Kong lost the chance to host a key gathering of global finance ministers 12 years ago as pro-democracy protests loomed. Now, Beijing is giving it another chance in a city where its tightening grip has made such dissent all but unthinkable.

title: Asian Stocks Set for Gains as Tech Selloff Eases: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian equities were primed to rebound Friday after dip buyers powered a recovery on Wall Street from a chip-stock selloff fueled by concerns about the artificial intelligence trade. Treasuries rallied on haven demand and the dollar slipped.

title: MSCI Weighs Indonesia Downgrade, Removal From Global Indexes
summary: Indonesia faces a potential ejection from global stock indexes after MSCI Inc. said the country no longer merits emerging-market status, escalating the threat of foreign investor flight as concerns deepen over market integrity.
